title: Pause Allowances on an Appointment Series
content:
**Desk guidance — Patient Services Center.** An Appointment Series may be paused for a limited number of times and for a limited period, both set by its visit format.

| Visit format | Pauses allowed on one series | Longest a series may stay paused before it is cancelled (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 1 | 21 |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 2 | 30 |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 2 | 30 |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 1 | 21 |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 1 | 30 |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 1 | 14 |

**What the figures mean.** "Pauses allowed" is the maximum number of pauses taken on one series over its life. "Longest paused" is the maximum number of calendar days the series may stay paused before it is cancelled.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).**

- A Standard 45-Minute Visit Series that has been paused once may be paused a second time; an Aquatic Therapy Visit Series that has been paused once has used its only pause.
- The Post-Operative Priority Visit Series has the shortest pause period, 14 calendar days; the Standard, Extended and Specialty formats have the longest, 30 calendar days.
